opportunities.title: Wanted-item sourcing service
opportunities.hypothesis: People with unusually specific shopping needs will pay to have an agent search multiple marketplaces and channels for a matching item.
opportunities.target_buyer: Collectors and shoppers with a highly specific wanted item
opportunities.offer: Submit a wanted item; receive a ranked shortlist and sourcing help.
opportunities.smallest_test: Manually source 10 highly specific requests from existing communities and offer a NZ$15 paid hunt.
execution_steps: Manually source 10 highly specific requests from existing communities and offer a NZ$15 paid hunt.

opportunities.title: Billboard-as-a-service scarce digital property
opportunities.hypothesis: People will pay for a scarce, visible digital placement when ownership, scarcity, permanence, or attention is clearly packaged.
opportunities.target_buyer: Creators, collectors, small businesses and communities seeking a persistent digital placement
opportunities.offer: Buy a defined scarce placement with a clear term, location, and proof of ownership/use.
opportunities.smallest_test: Publish one tightly defined scarce placement and solicit 10 qualified prospects.
execution_steps: Publish one tightly defined scarce placement and solicit 10 qualified prospects.

opportunities.title: Commander deck diagnostic
opportunities.hypothesis: Commander players will pay for a fast diagnostic that identifies weaknesses and gives concrete upgrades.
opportunities.target_buyer: Commander players who want an actionable deck review
opportunities.smallest_test: Put the existing NZ$29 offer in front of 20 qualified Commander owners and measure purchases.
execution_steps: Put the existing NZ$29 offer in front of 20 qualified Commander owners and measure purchases.

opportunities.title: Audience pain intelligence brief
opportunities.hypothesis: Creators and small operators will pay for concise, evidence-backed briefs that turn Reddit/Substack/community signals into actionable commercial opportunities.
opportunities.offer: A one-off commercial signal brief with source evidence, buyer hypothesis and smallest test.
opportunities.smallest_test: Create one sample brief from public community signals and offer it to 10 qualified prospects.
execution_steps: Create one sample brief from public community signals and offer it to 10 qualified prospects.

opportunities.title: License existing digital artifacts as commercial kits
opportunities.hypothesis: Existing diagrams, templates, specifications and automation artifacts can be packaged and licensed as useful operator kits rather than remaining internal documentation.
opportunities.target_buyer: AI builders, operators and small businesses
opportunities.offer: One-off commercial kit containing a focused artifact bundle and usage instructions.
opportunities.smallest_test: Select one artifact bundle, write a one-page buyer-facing description, and test it with 10 qualified prospects.
execution_steps: Select one artifact bundle, write a one-page buyer-facing description, and test it with 10 qualified prospects.

opportunities.title: Digital billboard slot as a service
opportunities.hypothesis: People and small businesses will pay for a permanent or time-bounded claim on a visible digital property surface.
opportunities.target_buyer: Creators, small businesses, collectors, and internet-native projects wanting durable attention.
opportunities.smallest_test: Sell one clearly bounded NZ$29-NZ$99 digital billboard slot with a defined placement, duration, and proof of publication.
opportunities.kill_condition: No qualified buyer interest after 20 targeted exposures, or fulfilment cannot be proven deterministically.

opportunities.title: ELoM creator asset revival
opportunities.hypothesis: Existing game-world artifacts can be refined into a small paid creator or player experience without rebuilding the entire historical system.
opportunities.target_buyer: Players, creators, collectors, and fans of persistent digital worlds.
opportunities.channel: Existing ELoM artifacts, community discovery, Substack, Reddit
channels: Existing ELoM artifacts, community discovery, Substack, Reddit
opportunities.smallest_test: Archaeologise one coherent historical mechanic, package a tiny playable or demonstrable slice, and test paid interest before rebuilding the wider game.
opportunities.kill_condition: Artifact cannot be reconstructed coherently, or no qualified demand appears after a bounded demonstration test.

opportunities.title: Wanted-item sourcing service
opportunities.hypothesis: People will pay a small fee to have an agent search multiple commerce channels for a highly specific hard-to-find item.
opportunities.target_buyer: Collectors and shoppers with precise item, size, style, condition, or price requirements.
opportunities.channel: Reddit, Substack, direct referrals, marketplace adapters
channels: Reddit, Substack, direct referrals, marketplace adapters
opportunities.smallest_test: Offer a manually fulfilled NZ$15-NZ$29 wanted-item hunt to 10 qualified prospects without depending on one marketplace.
opportunities.kill_condition: Fewer than 2 qualified prospects from the first 10-target test, or acquisition cost exceeds the test ceiling.
